abstract: Covers SMTP MTA Strict Transport Security (MTA-STS). RFC 8461 SMTP MTA Strict Transport Security (MTA-STS) is current; RFC 8460 SMTP TLS Reporting is current. Requirements are quotes from the pinned text. SKILL.md holds the workflow; references split versions and the quoted requirements.
